body.title: fix(team): suppress the permission drift of teams without admin access
body.body:
Fixes the `permission` part of #194 (and the drift reported in #135).

Gitea's team API parses the incoming permission against `none` and `admin` only, and keeps the per-unit access in the team units. A team sent with `read` or `write` is therefore stored, and read back, as `none`, and every plan proposes `permission = "none" -> "write"`. `none` cannot be configured instead, because the SDK's `Validate` refuses to send it (`permission mode invalid`).

This adds a `DiffSuppressFunc` to `permission` that suppresses only `none` (state) against `read`/`write` (config). Real changes still show: `none -> admin`, `admin -> write`, and `read <-> write` on servers that do store them.

It does not make `permission = "none"` configurable; that needs the SDK to accept `none`. It also does not touch the `units` string drift, which #196 addresses.

Tested with a unit test for the suppress function, `go vet`, and `go test ./...`. Seen against Gitea 1.26.2 with provider 0.8.1.

body.title: feat: build default images without catthehacker
body.body:
Build the default images in this repository instead of on top of the unmaintained `catthehacker/ubuntu:act-*` images.

The catthehacker `act-*` images are a setup script on top of the official `buildpack-deps` image, so `dockerfiles/ubuntu.dockerfile` now builds from `buildpack-deps:<version>` and installs the same tool set directly:

- git from the git-core PPA, git-lfs from packagecloud (3.8.0, so the upgrade step from #33 is no longer needed)
- Docker CLI with Buildx and Compose from download.docker.com, instead of Microsoft's moby packages. The unused Docker daemon is no longer installed and the Microsoft apt source is gone.
- Node.js 24, checked against the official SHASUMS256 file. Node 20 is dropped since it is end of life.
- yq, checked against its published SHA256
- Python with pip, venv and pipx, jq, and the other packages from catthehacker's list
- `safe.directory '*'`, the `ImageOS` and related environment variables, and `/opt/hostedtoolcache` and `/github`

The bundled Node is also registered in `/opt/hostedtoolcache/node/<version>/<arch>` with a `.complete` marker, so `setup-node` with a matching version uses it instead of downloading.

Full images are now copied directly from `ghcr.io/christopherhx/runner-images`, which is where catthehacker's `full-*` images were copied from.

The 24.04 image is about 450 MB smaller than before, because the Docker daemon and its dependencies are no longer installed.

Fixes #34
Fixes #19
Fixes #24
Fixes #26
Fixes #27
Refs #32
